name: Exaiphanes Blade
passiveDesc: When the Traveler equips this, their ATK will increase by 16/20/24/32% at Refinement Ranks 1/2/3/4 for 8s after they hit an opponent. At the same time, they will also regenerate 3/3/5/5 Elemental Energy. This effect can trigger once every 5s, even when the Traveler is off-field. From Refinement Rank 2 onward, the Traveler's CRIT DMG also increases by 6% for every Element they have resonated with, up to 42% for seven Elements.
location: Archon Quest: Great Deeds on the Tundra
description: A longsword that once shone with the Pale Star's light. In the voyager's hand, it becomes a brand-new light that has nothing to do with any past era.

modifiers.label: Traveler ATK after hitting an opponent
Traveler CRIT DMG per Element previously resonated with (up to 7; not party composition)
